title: Geometric dictionary for stalk and infinitesimal quotient cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], with $Y$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], $\mathcal F$ coherent [pqf-def-coherent], $y\in Y$ and $p\ge0$. Put $A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$, $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m_y$, $c:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ the canonical map [lem-weil-pbc-spec-local-ring-canonical-morphism], $X'=\operatorname{Spec}A\times_YX$ with projections $f':X'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, $g':X'\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and $\mathcal F'=g'^*\mathcal F$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $J=\mathfrak m\mathcal O_{X'}$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal] and let $C$ be $H^p(X',-)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] regarded as an $A$-module by $A\to\Gamma(X',\mathcal O_{X'})$. Put $M=(R^pf_*\mathcal F)_y$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], $Q_n=C(\mathcal F'/J^{n+1}\mathcal F')$ with its quotient transitions [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $B_n=H^p(X_n,\mathcal F_n)$ with the canonical transitions and scalar actions [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. Then $\mathcal F'$ is coherent, and there exist an $A$-linear equivalence $a:M\to C(\mathcal F')$, an isomorphism of inverse systems $b:Q\to B$ after restricting scalars from $\widehat A$ to $A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $A$-linear maps $\kappa_n:M\to B_n$ satisfying IsFormalFunctionsTheta [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology], such that $\kappa_n(z)=b_n(C(q_n)(a(z)))$ for every $n\ge0$ and $z\in M$, where $q_n:\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F'/J^{n+1}\mathcal F'$ is the quotient projection. This assertion concerns uncompleted cohomology and finite-level quotient systems; it asserts no isomorphism involving a completed cohomology module or a limit.

proof.text: Prove coherence of the local pullback. Properness and the Noetherian stalk give locally Noetherian sources; coherence gives quasi-coherence and finite type. Transfer Mathlib pullback quasi-coherence through uniqueness of left adjoints for tensorPullback, and use the finite-type pullback theorem. Apply the coherence characterization.

Take the stalk equivalence a with its canonical germ formula. Take the finite quotient comparison b and maps r. Define kappa_n=(r_n).comp a.toLinearMap. The finite quotient comparison applied to the germ formula proves IsFormalFunctionsTheta. Its pointwise quotient identity evaluated at a(z) proves the final equality. Combine these witnesses with the coherence proof.

lean.statement:
theorem formalFunctions_local_dictionary {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (y : Y) (p : ℕ) :
    let X' := pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f
    let f' := pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f
    let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F
    let J := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      ((maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).map
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv.hom)).comap f'
    let C := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X'.toRingedSpace p ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫ f'.appTop).hom
    RingedSpace.IsCoherent X'.toRingedSpace F' ∧
      ∃ a : formalFunctionsStalk f y F p ≃ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y] C.obj F',
      ∃ b : formalCompletionSystem J F' ⋙ C ≅
        formalFibreCohomologySystem f y F p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
            (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y))),
      ∃ κ : ∀ n : ℕ, formalFunctionsStalk f y F p →ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
        formalFibreCohomologyLocal f y F p n,
        (∀ n : ℕ, IsFormalFunctionsTheta f y F p n (κ n)) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsStalk f y F p),
          κ n z = (b.hom.app (op n))
            ((C.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F')) (a z))
